title: Data Scientist, Credit Risk
description_html:
About the role

Our credit risk team models how lending portfolios behave under stress.

What you'll do

  • Build credit risk models with Python and sklearn
  • Run time series studies of loan performance
  • Present findings to risk committees; clear communication is essential

What you bring

  • A Master's degree in statistics, economics or a related field
  • Strong SQL
  • Experience with forecasting

Nice to have

  • Spark
  • Tableau or Power BI

Pay and benefits

  • Salary: $95,000–$112,000 CAD per year
  • Four weeks of vacation and a yearly learning budget
